To: All Department Supervisors
From: Adrian Eastman, Purchasing Manager
Date: June 4
Subject: Copier trial results
The trial of the CP-200 and the CP-450 has ended. Every area kept a page count for each working day, and all reports are in. Those figures let us compare the models on the 135 ------- volume they handle.
Running costs were nearly equal, so reliability decided the choice. The CP-200 kept stopping partway through long jobs. The CP-450 136 ------- our standard copier on July 1. Under heavy use it produced several hundred pages a day and caused none of the 137 ------- that supervisors described. Existing machines stay in service until replacement is due.
Requests for new units should come to this office. Each delivery includes a short setup session on site. 138 -------.
Thank you for taking part. Please send any questions to me.

A: Trial records should be returned to this office by Friday
B: Let us know which of the two models your area prefers
C: Regular users of the copier should attend that session
D: Existing machines will be collected during the same visit

Kitchenware and small appliances are now at the front of the floor, and the garden department has moved to the lower level. 145 -------. New signs hang above every aisle, and a printed floor guide is available at the main doors.
